grasp.source: HERO Dex3 side grasp: offset (0.077, 0.055, 0), wrist yaw 45 deg outward, 6.5 cm above table

protocol.palm_box_constrains: grasp palm xy and nominal place palm xy (pregrasp / lift / transport waypoints are not constrained)
protocol.close_mode: ramp closure until thumb + index/middle touch, then HERO-demo full closure with squeeze; touch also gates the lift
protocol.place_target: cup's true in-hand offset measured after the lift (privileged sim state), palm orientation kept
protocol.cup_and_robot_state: exact simulator state (no perception, no odometry noise)
protocol.success: cup tilt < 10 deg, cup centre within coaster radius (5 cm), resting on the coaster (|dz| < 4 mm), robot never fell
protocol.fall_rule: pelvis z < 0.3 m, pelvis tilt > 60.0 deg, or a non-foot/hand body part on floor/table
